correctionsToThePlan: The coordinating matrix says To buy has an existing purchase-order action if the reader is authorised. It does not. demand_tab.dart ships with no buying affordance at all. The Transfer to PO action lives on an order row's overflow menu on the picking list, and the guide says so there.

The plan's frontmatter example quotes Load/Dispatch to lib/screens/dispatch/dispatch_screen.dart, which is correct, but Van is loaded and Van went out are constants in lib/models/dispatch_stage_words.dart and only reach the screens through it.
The matrix's Loading Sheet vocabulary is retired. The Loading tab no longer exists; its wire value resolves to the vans list, and the surface a customer meets is called Dispatch.
